cases.query: How many devices do we have and what vendors?
expected_behavior: reports the counts and the vendor mix from the result
uses kind interfaces with device atl-core-pe01
does not dump everything: relies on the default page size or sets a limit, and says how to see more

cases.query: Which hosts are behind switch atl-dc01-acc01?
expected_behavior: uses kind hosts with the device filter atl-dc01-acc01
reports hosts from the result (for example sjc-dc-12-server-4) and says when more remain

cases.query: What VLANs are configured on atl-dc01-acc01?
expected_behavior: uses kind vlans with the device filter
reports the VLANs from the result (default and VLAN0201)

cases.query: Can host A reach host B?
Is 10.1.1.77 inside a connected subnet, and whose?
Is this next hop address a device we model?
What routes, security group rules and gateways does this cloud VPC have?
expected_behavior: uses kinds cloud_routes, cloud_security and cloud_gateways
says what the cloud kinds do not cover (ACLs, firewalls, transit gateways) and that path search between instances is unverified
